assessments.battery: The battery capacity is a fixed user-supplied value, with power draw envelopes predicted from comparable model observations.
assessments.cpu: CPU performance is predicted via engineering transfer from recent flagship scores to the hypothetical Exynos chipset.
assessments.gpu: GPU frame rates and power draw are estimated using Aztec Ruins anchors and system-load observations.
assessments.thermal: Thermal resistance and capacitance are modeled based on system power anchors and lumped RC policy assumptions.
assessments.charging: Charging power tapers are predicted from existing 45W input ratings using a piecewise battery-side model.

limitations: Aftermarket pack specifications are reported analogies, not measurements of the target or its OEM battery.
Transfer envelopes are engineering judgments, not empirical confidence intervals or accuracy guarantees.
The supplied chipset name is not verified and earns no automatic performance uplift.
Lumped RC resistance is a policy sensitivity assumption; source load power does not measure thermal resistance.
Target network, signal, and display conditions are assumed for transfer modeling.
